title: Wemby Blocks Everything, But Not Losing Streaks
take: Wemby swats every shot but can’t stop the Spurs from losing every close fourth quarter on national TV.
style: crisp broadcast lighting, neutral colour grade, deep clarity

cast.name: Victor Wembanyama
cast.look: an extremely tall, very slim 7-foot-4 French basketball player with very long limbs, short dark hair and sharp youthful features, towering over everyone around him
cast.wardrobe: a plain solid black or silver basketball jersey with no logos, no numbers, no lettering

cast.name: a weary head coach
cast.look: a tired middle-aged basketball head coach holding a clipboard, sleeves rolled up, thousand-yard stare
cast.wardrobe: a plain grey polo shirt and dark trousers with no lettering

scenes.venue: packed basketball arena at night, bright broadcast lighting, blurred crowd
scenes.action: Wembanyama stands at the rim, casually swatting away a barrage of basketballs from unseen shooters. The air is full of rejected balls bouncing away in all directions. He looks unbothered as he blocks each one.
scenes.camera: low-angle medium shot from just below the basket, emphasizing his towering height
scenes.line: Defense? Blocked it. Layup? Blocked it. Dunk? Blocked it! I block everything.
scenes.delivery: comically matter-of-fact, barely breaking a sweat, a tiny grin

scenes.venue: dim locker room with black and silver stalls
scenes.action: Coach sits slumped on a bench, surrounded by piles of basketballs rolling everywhere. In the background, a scoreboard-style clock (no numbers) stuck at '4th quarter' spins endlessly. Wembanyama stands in the doorway, still in uniform, arms crossed helplessly.
scenes.camera: mid shot level with coach, showing Wemby looming in the background
scenes.line: He blocks every shot, but fourth quarters just block us from winning on national TV.
scenes.delivery: exhausted, resigned, shrugs, massaging his forehead
